# Search quality

*Generated by `cd backend && uv run python -m app.search_benchmark` (do not edit by hand). The cases are in `backend/app/search_benchmark.py`; pytest runs the same cases.*

43 queries. For the 40 queries with an expected result, rank = where that item comes in the results of its type (places or treks).

| Measure | Before V2 | Now |
|---|---|---|
| hit@1 (expected item first) | 72% | 92% |
| hit@3 (expected item in the top 3) | 72% | 100% |
| MRR (mean of 1 / rank) | 0.725 | 0.958 |
| "No result" queries that really return nothing | 67% | 100% |
